facts.fact: 他的自我约束宣言：保护她首先要防的是他自己——体型、粗手与体内的狼。
facts.anchor: protecting her meant protecting her from me

facts.fact: 她拒绝拖延：母亲眼线遍布，不圆房会被发现。
facts.anchor: My mother has spies everywhere. She'll know if we don't.

facts.fact: 他提议做搭档而非主从；她第一次正眼看他，但觉得他不及格。
facts.anchor: "It doesn't have to be that way. We can be partners."

facts.fact: 嫂子们的温柔忠告被她的冷血合同当场击碎——他一直把新婚妻子当玻璃捧。
facts.anchor: trying to handle my new wife like spun glass

facts.fact: 她解释身体细节的来历：母亲从青春期起就要求她 Wax，把她养成光溜的玩偶。
facts.anchor: My mother insisted I wax since puberty.

facts.fact: 他怒火的对象不是新娘而是 Sorsha——把女儿当秀马养了二十来年。
facts.anchor: At the woman who had spent twenty-something years treating her like a show pony.

facts.fact: 他抓到她冰甲上一闪而过的、难以置信的脆弱，随即被重新埋回石头层。
facts.anchor: A flash of raw, disbelieving vulnerability flickered across her features

facts.fact: 章末逼问：不为母亲、不为家族——说出你自己想要的。
facts.anchor: Not what your mother wants. Not what the pack wants. Tell me what you want.
